daj.evidence: RCS chi2(2): age 57.6, TC 41.8, HDL 18.5, BMI 11.6, waist 7.1 (all p < 0.05); PIR 0.8
daj.decision: L2 logistic regression + SplineTransformer(4 quantile knots, cubic, linear extrapolation) on continuous features; linear arm as ablation
daj.why_not_alternative: Linear logit under-fits the bends; categorisation is arbitrary; GAM/boosting not allowed (HR3) and less interpretable

daj.evidence: race x BMI p = 0.39, Asian x BMI p = 0.93 (MDE 0.70 log-OR / 5 kg/m²)
daj.decision: No interaction terms; Asian BMI bias handled as measurement (WHtR arm, S8)
daj.why_not_alternative: Interaction terms with this power add variance without detectable gain; 'not detectable' is not 'absent'

daj.evidence: VIF weight 95.7, BMI 97.6; BP readings 8.8-11.7; corr(log BMI, log W - 2 log H) = 0.99999
daj.decision: Average BP readings; exclude LDL; remove structural duplicates of BMI by in-fold iterative VIF > 10 pruning with BMI and waist protected (preparation step P05, which removes weight); L2 penalty as second line of defence
daj.why_not_alternative: Unprotected VIF deletion (could drop BMI or waist, which measure different aspects of adiposity; O'Brien 2007); PCA of body measures (loses interpretability); pruning on the full data (leaks into the folds)

daj.decision: Yeo-Johnson as a toggleable step fitted inside training folds; kept only if the S7 ablation supports it
daj.why_not_alternative: Transforming before the split leaks lambda; log fails at 0

daj.evidence: weighted 14.0% vs unweighted 16.9%; Kish deff 1.55; 60+ 46.2% vs 31.4%
daj.decision: Survey weights as an ablation block (B6) and weighted evaluation metrics alongside unweighted ones
daj.why_not_alternative: Ignoring weights (sample != population) or training only weighted (variance cost without tested benefit)

daj.evidence: insured-uninsured +5.3 -> +0.7 pp; 10 attenuations > 50% in the scan
daj.decision: Age always in the model; every group comparison age-standardised or age-adjusted
daj.why_not_alternative: Reading crude group gaps as access or ethnicity effects

daj.evidence: BMI is a descendant of race (DAG); back-door invalid with BMI
daj.decision: Model coefficients reported as conditional associations only; no causal language
daj.why_not_alternative: Table 2 fallacy: interpreting every coefficient as an effect

daj.evidence: clinical cut-points (BMI 25/30, age 45) and leakage need inspection
daj.decision: Secondary shallow decision tree (max_depth = 3, min_samples_leaf = 50) for threshold discovery and leak hunting only
daj.why_not_alternative: Deep trees / ensembles overfit and are outside HR3; a shallow tree is readable and exposes leaks as near-perfect splits

daj.evidence: TC U-shaped in binned log-odds (statins after diagnosis)
daj.decision: Tier-2 lipid coefficients carry a reverse-causation caveat
